en.headline: Customs seize 31kg dried shark fins at airport, charge mainland woman
en.dek: A 51-year-old woman from the mainland arriving from Brazil was arrested after officers found about 31 kilograms of suspected controlled dried shark fins in her checked baggage, valued at HK$130,000.
body: Hong Kong Customs said officers intercepted a 51-year-old mainland woman at the arrivals hall of Hong Kong International Airport on Saturday after she arrived on a flight from Brazil via Ethiopia. About 31 kilograms of suspected controlled dried shark fins, estimated to be worth HK$130,000, were found in her checked baggage.

Officers from the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department examined the fins and assessed that they belonged to a species listed under the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora. The items are regulated under the Protection of Endangered Species of Animals and Plants Ordinance in Hong Kong. Customs arrested the woman and handed the case to the department for follow-up.

The department has charged the woman with one count of illegal import of an Appendix II endangered species. Under the ordinance, anyone who imports, exports or possesses an endangered species without following the prescribed requirements commits an offence. Upon conviction, the maximum penalty is a fine of HK$10 million and imprisonment for 10 years, and the seized items are liable to confiscation.
Customs reminded the public that it maintains a 24-hour hotline at 182 8080 for reports of suspected smuggling activities.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲約31公斤乾魚翅 內地女旅客被控非法進口
zh.dek: 一名51歲內地女旅客從巴西經埃塞俄比亞抵港，海關在其寄艙行李檢獲約31公斤懷疑受管制乾魚翅，市值約13萬元，已交漁護署落案檢控。
body: 香港海關表示，周六在香港國際機場入境大堂截查一名從巴西經埃塞俄比亞飛抵本港的51歲內地女旅客，在其寄艙行李內發現約31公斤懷疑屬受管制瀕危物種的乾魚翅，估計市值約13萬元。
漁農自然護理署人員查驗後，懷疑該批乾魚翅屬《瀕危野生動植物種國際貿易公約》所列明的瀕危物種，受本港《保護瀕危動植物物種條例》管制。海關拘捕該名女子，案件已轉交漁護署跟進。
漁護署已落案控以一項非法進口附錄II瀕危物種罪。根據條例，任何人如非按照規定進出口或管有瀕危物種即屬違法，一經定罪最高可被判罰款一千萬元及監禁十年，有關物品亦會被充公。
海關呼籲市民如發現懷疑走私活動，可致電24小時熱線182 8080舉報。
